description: Source code for MPU6050 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including sensor data conversion, initialization, and data fetching functions.

methods.name: mpu6050_convert_accel
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: mpu6050_convert_gyro
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: mpu6050_convert_temp
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: mpu6050_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: mpu6050_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches new sensor data sample from device.

methods.name: mpu6050_init
methods.description: Initializes the MPU6050 device, sets ranges, and wakes up the sensor.
